decision_rule: Retire only after replacement coverage is proven and unique executable assets, external contracts, high-risk guardrails, and acceptance criteria have been preserved.

decisions.name: hermes-agent
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Replace incomplete local copies with the canonical managed mirror.
decisions.rationale: The complete upstream artifact set is the canonical Hermes capability.

decisions.name: graphify
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Remove the obsolete partial Python package snapshot and keep only the official Codex artifact set.
decisions.rationale: The old mixed snapshot is fully superseded by the maintained Codex distribution.

decisions.name: gsd-core
decisions.license_lineage: MIT with pinned release, npm digest, and SLSA provenance
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Manage only through explicit --bundle gsd-core installation; never flatten into canonical skills.
decisions.rationale: The official installer is the complete supported multi-client distribution.

decisions.name: gsd-pi
decisions.license_lineage: MIT with pinned release, npm digest, and SLSA provenance
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Keep listable and explicit-only; do not install in this release migration.
decisions.rationale: Pi remains useful for its native runtime but must not share Core .planning state.

decisions.name: hermes-graphify-gsd-nonintrusive-workflow
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Delete unchanged installer-owned copies; archive modified or unowned copies and retain a tombstone.
decisions.rationale: The thin router preserves the intent without duplicating upstream versions or state machines.

decisions.name: hermes-graphify-gsd-runtime-operator
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Delete unchanged installer-owned copies; archive modified or unowned copies and retain a tombstone.
decisions.rationale: Runtime ownership belongs to the official Hermes, Graphify, and GSD distributions.

decisions.name: hermes-graphify-gsd-project-integration
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Delete unchanged installer-owned copies; archive modified or unowned copies and retain a tombstone.
decisions.rationale: The new router covers selection and delegates implementation to complete official artifacts.

decisions.name: gsd-graphify-brownfield-bootstrap
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Archive user-modified copies; migrate the unique backup and rollback behavior before removing active copies.
decisions.rationale: The dedicated migration skill retains the only unique intent without duplicating GSD orchestration.

decisions.name: lore
decisions.license_lineage: permissive upstream license at reviewed checkpoint
decisions.local_cleanup_action: Follow the moved upstream path and preserve the canonical install.
decisions.rationale: The path moved, but the skill retains distinct value.
